# Step 1: list all files under the Amsterdam photographs directory
amsterdam_dir = '/home/melissa/photographs/vacations/amsterdam/'

files_listing = apis.file_system.show_directory(
    access_token=fs_token,
    directory_path=amsterdam_dir,
    entry_type='files',
    recursive=True
)

print('amsterdam_dir', amsterdam_dir)
print('files_count', len(files_listing) if isinstance(files_listing, list) else files_listing)
print('files_listing_sample', files_listing[:30] if isinstance(files_listing, list) else files_listing)

rel_list = apis.phone.show_contact_relationships(access_token=phone_token)
print('relationship_categories', rel_list)

# Choose relationship filter matching 'roommate' or similar
# We'll search for best match in returned list
candidates = [r for r in rel_list if 'room' in r.lower()]
print('roomlike_candidates', candidates)

relationship_to_use = candidates[0] if candidates else None
print('relationship_to_use', relationship_to_use)

# Fetch contacts with that relationship (paginate)
all_contacts = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
if relationship_to_use:
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship=relationship_to_use, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        # The API returns a list
        if not page:
            break
        all_contacts.extend(page)
        print('page', page_index, 'count', len(page), 'total', len(all_contacts))
        page_index += 1
else:
    print('No roommate-like relationship category found')

print('total_contacts_filtered', len(all_contacts))
print('sample_contacts', all_contacts[:10])

# Extract emails
emails = sorted({c['email'] for c in all_contacts if c.get('email')})
print('emails_count', len(emails))
print('emails', emails)

    access_token=fs_token,
    directory_path=vacations_parent,
    entry_type='files',
    recursive=False
)
print('vacations_parent', vacations_parent)
print('parent_files_count', len(listing_parent_files) if isinstance(listing_parent_files, list) else listing_parent_files)

# Prepare tokens (reuse if available)
if 'fs_token' not in globals() or not fs_token:
    creds = {a['account_name']: a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
    fs_token = apis.file_system.login(username='mel.bailey@gmail.com', password=creds['file_system'])['access_token']

if 'gmail_token' not in globals() or not gmail_token:
    creds = {a['account_name']: a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
    gmail_token = apis.gmail.login(username='mel.bailey@gmail.com', password=creds['gmail'])['access_token']

# Rooms emails (reuse if available)
if 'roommate_emails' not in globals() or not roommate_emails:
    if 'phone_token' not in globals() or not phone_token:
        creds = {a['account_name']: a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
        phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='3383946795', password=creds['phone'])['access_token']

    rel_list = apis.phone.show_contact_relationships(access_token=phone_token)
    roommate_rels = [r for r in rel_list if 'room' in r.lower()]
    relationship_to_use = roommate_rels[0] if roommate_rels else None

    all_contacts = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship=relationship_to_use, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not page:
            break
        all_contacts.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index > 50:
            break

    roommate_emails = sorted({c.get('email') for c in all_contacts if c.get('email')})

print('roommate_emails_count', len(roommate_emails))
print('roommate_emails', roommate_emails)

# Amsterdam directory and zip path
amsterdam_dir = '/home/melissa/photographs/vacations/amsterdam/'
zip_path = '/home/melissa/photographs/vacations/amsterdam.zip'

zip_exists_resp = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=fs_token, file_path=zip_path)
print('zip_exists', zip_exists_resp)

# Compress if zip doesn't exist
if not zip_exists_resp.get('exists', False):
    compress_resp = apis.file_system.compress_directory(
        access_token=fs_token,
        directory_path=amsterdam_dir,
        compressed_file_path=zip_path
    )
    print('compress_resp', compress_resp)
    created_zip_path = compress_resp['compressed_file_path']
else:
    created_zip_path = zip_path

# Ensure zip exists now
zip_exists_resp2 = apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=fs_token, file_path=created_zip_path)
print('zip_exists_after', zip_exists_resp2)

# Send one email with everyone as recipients
subject = 'Amsterdam trip photographs'
body = 'Hi!\n\nSharing all the photographs from our Amsterdam trip.\n\n— Melissa'

send_resp = apis.gmail.send_email(
    access_token=gmail_token,
    email_addresses=roommate_emails,
    subject=subject,
    body=body,
    attachment_file_paths=[created_zip_path],
    file_system_access_token=fs_token
)
print('send_resp', send_resp)

sent_email_id = send_resp.get('sent_email_id')

# Verification: show email details once
show_resp = apis.gmail.show_email(access_token=gmail_token, email_id=sent_email_id)
print('show_resp_email_id', show_resp.get('email_id'))
print('show_resp_recipients', [r.get('email') for r in show_resp.get('recipients', [])])
print('show_resp_attachments', [a.get('file_name') for a in show_resp.get('attachments', [])])
